theorems.name: Submission.eilenberg_fiber_open_content_upperSemicontinuous
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] (m : ℕ) (k : ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0∞) (Q : Set X) (f : X → Rn m), IsCompact Q → ContinuousOn f Q → UpperSemicontinuous (fun y : Rn m ↦ ⨅ (I : Finset ℕ) (O : ℕ → Set X) (_ : ∀ i ∈ I, IsOpen (O i) ∧ Metric.ediam (O i) < δ) (_ : Q ∩ f ⁻¹' {y} ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ I, O i), ∑ i ∈ I, Metric.ediam (O i) ^ k)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
